title: Field extra toilets
description: field/extra_toilets.yaml of the game pack: toilet booths placed on any map with the extra toilets option (an engine improvement, docs/modulos/apps/game.md). One entry gives the drawn booth, its solid cells, the toilet trigger cells in front and the toilet routine. Positions and rotations are on the original's axes and units, like the map table's toilets.

model.description: The booth's model, an asset id of the packs (a binary glTF in world units, +Y up, its open front to +Z).

map.description: The map id it is on.

position.description: The booth's middle, where the partner goes (x, z on the original's axes); on a cell corner (multiples of 100) it stands on exactly 2 x 2 cells.

facing.description: The original Y rotation (0-4095) its open front faces; the toilet trigger cells are in front.

model.description: This booth's own model, instead of the document's.
